depictions.name: Saikyo-ji
depictions.text: Saikyo-ji is a Buddhist temple in the former province of Ōmi, Japan, located on the western shore of Lake Biwa. In 1582, while the temple was still under construction, it was visited by the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke while they were traveling through the province.
